item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring cool weather to Guangdong today. Under the influence of a strong easterly airstream, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A broad band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea over the weekend. Another surge of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong early next week.
